'''Danu 23 (December 16)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - [[Siuan]] is assigned to work for [[Cetalia Delarme]], head of the [[Blue Ajah]]'s eyes-and-ears network. The [[Amyrlin]] gives [[Moiraine]] the task of distributing the bounty to those women who bore children during the specified period. [[Lan]]'s forces stop near [[Kinslayer's Dagger]], having pursued the retreating [[Aiel]] for more than two weeks. At [[Bukama]]'s urging, Lan agrees not to return to the [[Borderlands]] immediately, and the two head southward together, possibly to [[Illian]].
*{{ne|978}} - While depositing her first stipend from the [[White Tower]] at a [[Tar Valon]] bank, Moiraine learns of [[Gorthanes]]' attempt to gain access to her financial records, and that her bankers' message to her was never delivered.
